data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出把自演化限制在运行时Harness（指令/工具逻辑）的双环引擎与准入闸门，按留出历史误差筛选并部署修改，属方法类RSI。

scope_support.feedback_quote: the gated loop admitted 144 of 7,449 candidate changes, none of which worsened error on held-out history
scope_support.object_quote: self-evolution is reviewable only if it is confined to the runtime harness (instruction text, tool-call logic and primitive composition)
scope_support.persistence_quote: the same loops admitted 309 harmful changes and left missed flags above 10% in 49 of 90 runs
